resources.string: Calendar sync

Sync this account’s Google calendars with Android Calendar. Download only, or enable two-way sync to upload event changes in writable calendars selected for syncing. Recurring events, exceptions and reminders are included. Turning sync off keeps downloaded events. Choose calendars to sync in your Calendar app.
Sync calendars
Two-way event sync
Uploads are paused after a phone transfer. Downloaded events remain available. Resume when you are ready to upload your local event changes.
Resume uploads
Resolve calendar conflicts

This applies to all event conflicts currently held for this account. Keep phone changes uploads your local edits, replacing conflicting fields in Google Calendar. Use Google changes discards those local edits and uses the current Google events. New conflicts will still need your choice.
Keep phone changes
Use Google changes
Calendar access could not be enabled. Check calendar permissions and reconnect your account.
Last sync completed
Last sync completed, but some events could not be read and were skipped.
Some local changes need review or could not be uploaded. Local changes and the Google version were preserved.
Calendar data could not be applied. Local data was retained; try again.

The Google Calendar app keeps this phone’s calendar in sync with Google. Cyclon’s own calendar sync steps aside while it does, and takes over again if that app is removed, disabled or loses its calendar permission.

Two-way sync is on for %1$s, so the Google Calendar app’s sync is not used. Cyclon’s calendar sync keeps every account in sync; switch every account to download only to let the Google Calendar app take over.
The Google Calendar app could keep this phone’s calendar in sync, but Cyclon’s calendar sync could not remove its own calendars first (it needs calendar permission for that), so it keeps syncing.
Android did not give calendar sync to the Google Calendar app, so Cyclon’s calendar sync took over again. It tries again after that app is updated.
On by default, download only. Choose here to turn it off or sync both ways.
On: kept in sync by the Google Calendar app
On: the Google Calendar app keeps this account’s calendars in sync.
Off: sync for this account is off in Android’s account settings, so the Google Calendar app does not sync it either.
The Google Calendar app had not synced %1$s after 6 hourly checks online, so Cyclon’s calendar sync took over again. It tries again after that app is updated.

plurals.item: %1$d change made while the Google Calendar app was syncing was not uploaded. It stays on this phone only. To upload it, turn the Google Calendar app back on (installed, enabled, with calendar access), or make the change again in Google Calendar on the web.

%1$d changes made while the Google Calendar app was syncing were not uploaded. They stay on this phone only. To upload them, turn the Google Calendar app back on (installed, enabled, with calendar access), or make the changes again in Google Calendar on the web.
